adaptations.withheld: sacred or restricted dance: no teaching adaptations

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Hands often held in Pataka or Anjali mudras; arms move in geometric lines.
movement_profile.footwork: Precise rhythmic tapping and stepping that mirrors the mridangam beats.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Stationary or limited forward/backward movement on a single axis.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Torso remains stable while the lower body maintains the Araimandi position.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Transitions between standing, half-sitting, and occasionally full-sitting; no high jumps.
movement_profile.posture: Erect spine, transitioning into Araimandi (half-sit) with knees turned out.

signature_moves.description: Stylized neck movements performed in isolation to the rhythm.
signature_moves.name: Griva Bheda

signature_moves.description: The foundational half-seated posture with knees pointed outward.
signature_moves.name: Araimandi

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Starts with slow, deliberate isolations and builds to a brisk rhythmic finish.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid facial expressions (abhinaya) as this is pure Nritta; do not lose the turnout in the knees during Araimandi.

music_profile.meter: Variable (3, 4, 5, 7, or 9 beats depending on the Jathi)
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Solkattu (rhythmic syllables) recited by the Nattuvanar
music_profile.sound_description: The sound is dominated by the sharp, resonant strikes of the mridangam and the crisp, percussive vocalizations of the Nattuvanar. There is no melodic singing, creating a focused, rhythmic atmosphere that highlights the dancer's footwork.
music_profile.tempo_bpm: Variable, typically starting slow and increasing in intensity

basic_steps: Stand in Samapada (feet together) with hands in Anjali Mudra above the head.
Execute Griva Bheda (neck movements) in sync with the rhythmic syllables.
Perform Drishti Bheda (eye movements) following the hand placements.
Lower the body into Araimandi (half-sit) while extending the arms.
Execute rhythmic footwork patterns (Adavus) matching the specific Jathi.
teaching.level_notes: The first piece a student learns; focuses on basic posture and rhythmic timing.
teaching.rhythm: Based on one of five Jathis (rhythmic patterns)
